annotations.title: Florida town names and weird spots

description: Short true stories pinned all over Florida, closest first: Name game (why a town is called what it is: Pass-a-Grille, Kissimmee, Key West...) and Weird Florida (Koreshan hollow-earth camp, the world's smallest police station, Robert the Doll...). Each has a teaser, the spot and a map link; the whole story opens in the Headed Back app at the place. Great as road-trip stops.
